sources.citation: English Wikipedia, 'Kam language' and 'Nuoxi language' (wikitext, downloaded 2026-09-17)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. States (citing 邵阳市志 1997 and 绥宁县志 1997) that Lianmin Yao is a variety close to Southern Kam spoken by people classified as Yao, closely related to Nuoxi Yao of Dongkou County.

sources.citation: 绥宁县人民政府 [Suining County People's Government] (主办: 中共绥宁县委、绥宁县人民政府). n.d. (archived 2025-10-16). 绥宁文化 ·【地方语言】 [Suining culture: local languages]. County government portal page www.hnsn.gov.cn/hnsn/snwhh/listn_tnew.shtml (text condensed from the 方言 chapter of the county gazetteer); read from Internet Archive archived copy (Internet Archive, 16 Oct 2025).
sources.note: No phonology for the Yao lect. The 【地方语言】 section (533 characters) says the county has four languages (汉语、苗语、侗语、瑶语); that 黄桑坝哪苗语、多龙侗语、小黄瑶语 are spoken 'comparatively pure' within the community, speakers switching to Chinese with outsiders; then gives initials/finals/tone counts only for 坝哪话 (32 声母, 40 韵母), 关峡平话 (18/31, 5 tones '除轻声外'), 东山话 (19/35, 6 tones) and 麻塘话 -- the Han-based lect of 麻塘、河口、竹舟江、枫木团、联民 townships (19/38, 5 tones '除轻声外'). Nothing on the tones, stress or syllable prominence of 小黄瑶语.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page lian1256 (classification comment citing Andrew Hsiu 2014 p.c.)
sources.note: Nothing; catalogue entry with one reference (the 1997 gazetteer).

sources.citation: 李康澄 [Li Kangcheng]. 2011. 绥宁汉语方言音韵比较研究 [Comparative Studies on Phonology of Suining Dialects in Hunan Province]. 博士学位论文 (PhD thesis), 厦门大学 Xiamen University. (Open repository preview, 17 pp.: abstracts, TOC, ch.1 pp.1-4; later published as a book of the same title, cf. 现代语文 2022(7):97.)
sources.note: Preview contains no phonology of the Yao/Kam variety: abstract ('县内不但有湘语和赣语两种汉语方言，还有苗语、侗语、瑶语等少数民族语言和关峡平话'), TOC (声母/韵母/声调 chapters are about the Chinese dialects), and pp.1-4 of ch.1 (geography, ethnic history, list of the 14 民族乡 incl. 联民苗族瑶族乡). Footnote p.4 cites 刘柏生、刘宗平、袁公湘《绥宁民族志》(中央民族大学出版社 2008) -- a county ethnic gazetteer likely to carry a 民族语言 section on 联民瑶话 (new print-only pointer, not seen).

sources.citation: ABVD (Austronesian Basic Vocabulary Database) entry 974 'Yao (Lianmin)', typed by Andrew C. Hsiu from 绥宁县志 (1997)
sources.note: Nothing. Wordlist only, every item with Chao tone values (55, 33, 25, 52, 213, 31, 54..); notes field only gives location and ~1,500 ethnic Yao in Suining.
